# Growth Career: Fan to Pro

Career track for international students in Korea who want to break into the K-pop industry.

## About
- 4-week K-pop industry bootcamp
- For international students living in Korea (D-2, D-4, D-10, E-series visas)
- 30 seats, 880,000 KRW (20% OFF, original 1,100,000 KRW)
- Deadline: Sunday, June 21, 2026 midnight KST
- First class: Saturday, June 27, 2026
- Last class: Sunday, July 19, 2026
- Graduation: Saturday, July 25, 2026

## Curriculum
- 8 sessions over 4 weekends (Saturday and Sunday, 2 hours each, 16 hours total)
- Saturday class: Live sound directing for K-pop major TV shows and festivals
- Sunday class: A&R, visual directing, and stage sound directing (K-pop label, 27 years; K-pop major stages, 20 years)
- Top graduates: real K-pop concert project work with a stipend

## Faculty
- 3 working K-pop industry mentors
- Categories: live sound director, A&R and visual director, stage sound director
- Lectures delivered in Korean (basic conversational Korean required)

## Credentials Awarded
- Certificate of Completion: issued by Dropdown Co., Ltd. (4-week program)
- Concert project participation letter: issued by Union Pictures (for graduates who work the actual K-pop concert)

## Pricing and Payment
- Tuition: 880,000 KRW (VAT included, 20% off the original 1,100,000 KRW)
- Payment method: bank transfer only (Toss Bank 1002-4759-1521, account holder Dropdown)
- Credit cards and foreign-issued cards are not supported
- Full refund within 7 days of payment or before the program starts
- Pro-rated refund per Korean Private Education Act Enforcement Decree (Table 4) after the program starts
- Class cancels and 100% auto-refund if fewer than 20 students enroll by the deadline
